confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cebu price levels, not live listings. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and guesthouse rates vary widely by area (IT Park/Lahug vs. Mactan vs. downtown) and season, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 0.6955 USD per AUD observation (15 Oct 2026, 4pm) was reported on the RBA exchange rates page in search results, but I did not read the F11 table directly. No RBA fixing for 16 Oct 2026 was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Philippine price basis (Visayas mid-sized city with tourism demand), set below Manila-level prices for food and accommodation and above the cheapest provincial options.
